verdict.rationale: Fedora's Workstation page explicitly claims developers can 'use the latest container tools from the Red Hat ecosystem. No setup required,' with access to the Red Hat container registry and 'high-efficiency tools for creating, running and managing containers.' That matches the story's core directly, but the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: named tools or in-depth docs on what ships preinstalled, and independent or hands-on confirmation that containers work out of the box.
